toolData.description: Interact with Google Gemini AI models for audio, vision, and language processing.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Select the Gemini model to use.

fields.name: prompt
fields.placeholder: e.g. Hello, how can you help me?

fields.name: audioUrl
fields.description: Publicly accessible URL of the audio file to process

fields.name: documentUrl
fields.description: Publicly accessible URL of the document file to process

fields.name: fileUrl
fields.description: Publicly accessible URL of the file to upload

fields.name: fileSearchStoreName
fields.description: The File Search store resource name (for example: fileSearchStores/my-store-id)

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Display name for the new File Search store

fields.name: fileDisplayName
fields.description: Display name for the uploaded document in the File Search store

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Maximum number of stores to return per page (1 to 20)

fields.name: pageToken
fields.description: Pagination token from a previous list response

fields.name: forceDelete
fields.description: Delete all related documents in the store as well

fields.name: inputDataFieldName
fields.description: The name of the input binary field to process. Leave as data, or use your form file field name such as image.

fields.name: maxTokens
fields.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate for Analyze Audio and Analyze Document.

fields.name: startTime
fields.description: Start timestamp for transcription range. Example: 00:00:30 or 30s.

fields.name: endTime
fields.description: End timestamp for transcription range. Example: 00:02:00 or 120s.
